summary: Iteration 12 targeted fix verification (backend + frontend). New backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_status_literal_acl.py (17 tests) — ALL PASS: POST /projects rejects status='garbage' with 422 and accepts all 4 valid statuses + defaults to 'active'; PATCH /projects rejects garbage with 422 (old value preserved) and accepts all 4; manager who is NOT a project member now gets 403 on PATCH (and cannot see the project in GET /projects) while a manager added as project member can PATCH name+status successfully; org 'member' still 403; unknown pid 403/404; anon 401. Full suite re-run serially (-n 0): 191 passed / 2 failed — both are the pre-existing, explicitly out-of-scope failures (test_iter10 missing_org_404 = 403-vs-404, test_project_members admin-as-lead data drift). The iteration-11 real bug (create accepts invalid status) is now fixed; I also relaxed the old test_patch_invalid_status assertion from 400 to 400/422. Frontend (Playwright, admin + member): FIX 3 verified — member opening ProjectDialog from the sprint card gets Name/Description/Status/Color all disabled, no Save changes button, no Delete button, 'You have view-only access to this project.' amber note shown, and the button reads 'Close' (no 'Cancel'); typing into Name is impossible. FIX 4 verified — a project force-set to status='garbage' in Mongo renders the ACTIVE badge with no 'undefined' class. Regression verified: admin login, create project WITH status select (project-create-status now exists — the iter11 spec miss is fixed; created with Planning badge), edit -> Archived save, delete cascade, sprint status filter + Clear, all 5 task views (list/board/gantt/calendar/workload), /analytics, /team, /members, /dashboard — no console/UI errors.

minor.issue: Unknown org id returns 403 'Not a member of this organization' instead of 404 (test_iter10_profile_org.py::test_missing_org_404).

Still does not exist — invited test users can only be purged directly from MongoDB (cleanup_iter11_users.py). Unchanged from iter11.

ui_bugs.issue: canManage gating was applied only to the Details tab. An org 'member' viewing the dialog still sees the per-member Delete (trash) buttons and the whole 'Add a member' block (select + Add button) enabled; clicking them will just 403. Gate the Members tab actions with the same canManage flag (read-only list for members).

No fallback for an unknown/legacy status: with status='garbage' the SelectTrigger renders completely blank (Projects.jsx now falls back to Active, the dialog does not). Use STATUS_OPTS.some(o=>o.v===project.status) ? project.status : 'active' when seeding the form.

issues: Disabled Name/Description text renders very light gray (disabled opacity) — the actual values are hard to read for a view-only user; consider disabled+readOnly styling with darker text so the data stays legible
Amber 'You have view-only access to this project.' note has no data-testid — add e.g. data-testid="project-view-only-note" for stable assertions

14 leftover TEST_Project / TEST_AutoLead projects (created by test_project_members / test_iter8 / test_iter9 suites, never deleted) clutter the grid and every project dropdown — those suites need teardown
Start/Due date still use native browser date inputs instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: Gate ProjectDialog's Members tab with canManage (hide remove-member trash icons and the Add-a-member block for org members) — currently the read-only fix stops at the Details tab.
Add a status fallback when seeding ProjectDialog's form so an unknown status does not render a blank Select trigger.
Add data-testid to the amber view-only note.

Optional/pre-existing: 403-vs-404 on PATCH /orgs/{unknown}; seeded admin project_role drift on 'Web Redesign'; no DELETE for org members; test-data pollution (14 TEST_* projects) from older ACL suites.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1/2 implementation is correct and single-sourced: Literal['planning','active','on_hold','archived'] on both ProjectCreate and ProjectUpdate; update_project now starts with require_project_access() and then the role check, matching the rest of the ACL model.

update_project builds updates via {k: v for ... if v is not None}, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. description='' works but null does not) — acceptable, but note PATCH cannot unset optional fields.
server.py is still ~1300 lines; router split (auth/orgs/projects/tasks/analytics) remains overdue.

invite_member still does not validate the role string (any value persists into memberships) — same class of bug that was just fixed for project status; use Literal['owner','admin','manager','member'] on MemberInvite.

rca_of_the_issue: No new defects in the fixed areas. Residual: ProjectDialog's canManage guard was applied only to the Details tab inputs/Save, so the Members tab actions (remove-member, add-member) remain enabled for role=member and fail with a 403 toast; and the dialog seeds form.status directly from project.status without validating it against STATUS_OPTS, so a legacy/invalid value renders an empty SelectTrigger (Projects.jsx already has statusStyle/statusLabel fallbacks).
